items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I hear Sonny Valor is playing... That's man, what a good – And they were lerted... They knew.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because in the first place I blamed everything else for my drinking other than what the fault really was. And then finally I realized that like I'm the one that was doing the drinking, but the reason I drank was because I was being praised. You know. Said, "Boy. Oh, man. You sure sound great." Stuff like that. And I didn't know anything. You see, when you don't know something and people keep telling you, "Boy, you're great. You're great." You say, "I'm great." But I'm not doing anything. And I don't know…
It sounds like that was a real turning point in your life, the time that you spent there.
